# Library

```{r library}
library(jsonlite)

```


## Data cleaning (EDA)
```{r eda}


api_key = ["*ADD YOUR API HERE*"]

url <- paste0(
  "https://api.census.gov/data/2024/acs/acs5?",
  "get=NAME,B01003_001E,B19013_001E,B25077_001E,B25064_001E,B25001_001E",
  "&for=county:*&in=state:*",
  "&key=", api_key
)


data <- fromJSON(url)
data <- as.data.frame(data[-1, , drop = FALSE])


# Region mappings using 2-digit stat_num
northeast_fips <- c("09", "23", "25", "33", "34", "36", "42", "44", "50")
midwest_fips   <- c("17", "18", "19", "20", "26", "27", "29", "31", "38", "39", "46", "55")
south_fips     <- c("01", "05", "10", "11", "12", "13", "21", "22", "24", "28", "37", "40", "45", "47", "48", "51", "54")
west_fips      <- c("02", "04", "06", "08", "15", "16", "30", "32", "35", "41", "49", "53", "56")



# Rename columns
names(data) <- c(
  "County", "Population", "Median_Household_Income",
  "Median_Home_Value", "Median_Gross_Rent",
  "Housing_Units", "State_num", "County_Code"
)

# Convert columns to numbers
numeric_cols <- c(
  "Population", "Median_Household_Income",
  "Median_Home_Value", "Median_Gross_Rent", "Housing_Units"
)

data <- data %>%
  # Convert and clean geographical strings
  mutate(
    across(all_of(numeric_cols), as.numeric),
    State_num   = str_pad(State_num, 2, pad = "0"),
    County_Code = str_pad(County_Code, 3, pad = "0"),
    State_name  = str_trim(sub(".*, ", "", County)),
    GEOID       = paste0(State_num, County_Code),
    
    # Categorize by  region
    Region = case_when(
      State_num %in% northeast_fips ~ "Northeast",
      State_num %in% midwest_fips   ~ "Midwest",
      State_num %in% south_fips     ~ "South",
      State_num %in% west_fips      ~ "West",
      TRUE                          ~ "Other/Unknown"
    )
  ) %>%
  # Replace negative values with NA 
  mutate(
    across(all_of(numeric_cols), ~ if_else(.x < 0, NA_real_, .x))
  )

# 50 states and Washington, D.C.
valid_states <- setdiff(sprintf("%02d", 1:56), c("03", "07", "14", "43", "52"))

data <- data %>% 
  filter(State_num %in% valid_states)


# Check the data
head(data)
print("data diminsions")
dim(data)
print("na sum")
sum(is.na(data))
```


## Graphs
```{r graph mhi_v_mhv}

ggplot(data, aes(x = Median_Household_Income, y = Median_Home_Value, color = Region)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Household Income vs. Home Value",
    x = "Median Household Income ($)",
    y = "Median Home Value ($)"
  ) +
  theme_gray()

```

```{r graph mhi_v_p}
ggplot(data, aes(x = Median_Household_Income, y = Population, color = Region)) +

```

# Maps
```{r map_setup}

options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

valid_states <- c(
  sprintf("%02d", 1:2),
  sprintf("%02d", 4:6),
  sprintf("%02d", 8:13),
  sprintf("%02d", 15:42),
  sprintf("%02d", 44:51),
  sprintf("%02d", 53:56)
)

counties <- tigris::counties(cb = TRUE, year = 2024) %>%
  filter(STATEFP %in% valid_states) %>%
  select(GEOID, geometry)

map_data <- left_join(counties, data, by = "GEOID")


```

```{r zoom}
make_static_map <- function(variable, title, legend_title) {
  ggplot(map_data) +
    geom_sf(
      aes(fill = .data[[variable]]),
      color = NA
    ) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(
      name = legend_title,
      labels = scales::label_comma(),
      na.value = "gray90"
    ) +
    coord_sf(
      xlim = c(-180, -65),
      ylim = c(15, 73),
      expand = FALSE
    ) +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
    )
}
```


```{r Population}

make_static_map("Population", "Population by County", "Population")
```


```{r Median_Household_Income}
make_static_map("Median_Household_Income","Median Household Income by County", "Income ($)")
```


```{r Median_Home_Value}
make_static_map("Median_Home_Value", "Median Home Value by County", "Home Value ($)")
```


```{r Median_Gross_Rent}
make_static_map("Median_Gross_Rent", "Median Monthly Rent by County", "Rent ($)")
```


```{r Housing_Units}
make_static_map("Housing_Units","Housing Units by County", "Housing Units")
```
